scope: Proposition 9.7 (Complete-wall factorization) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 155. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the source tensor there are numbers an(R0, L) independent of both probes, with cL ≤ |an| ≤ CL, such that Hf (z, u) = an(R0, L)hn(z)Jn(u) + en(z, u; R0, L), lim R0→∞ lim sup n→∞ sup (z,u)∈K |en| = 0 (9.54) for each compact probe set K, with sufficiently large fixed L. Every locally uniform subsequential limit of Jn on the reserved strip is continuous and nonconstant. For the diagonal tensor, write µin for the interior deterministic-cap law, R∗ = dℓopen−ℓdet , and N(z) for all closed interior raw loops surrounding z. There is a probe-independent exterior scalar aI n(R0, L) such that the exact full-wall identity is Rf (z) = aI n(R0, L) Eµin [R∗σ(col(V (z)))DV (z)(2/d)N(z)] Eµin Uz . (9.55) For sufficiently large fixed L, lim inf R0→∞ lim inf n→∞ |aI n| > 0, lim sup R0→∞ lim sup n→∞ |aI n| < ∞. (9.56) No convergence of either scalar is required.
